integrity: Full analytic proof and claim boundaries supplied; no computational experiment is presented as an infinite proof; source attributions give original preprint submission date. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: The Garsia norm is used modulo constants; good boundary directions are chosen for each fixed function. No assertion about arbitrary equivalent norms, scalar c depending on r, or all ordinary extreme points in BMO. Publication priority and independent audit remain open.
title: Localized Blaschke max-laws and the absence of strongly extreme points in Garsia-norm balls
